user.title: Connect SmartTherm
user.description: Choose how to connect or replace this account’s session. Email/password sign-in discovers the account ID and token automatically. Passwords are used only for sign-in and are not saved.

menu_options.login: Sign in with email and password
menu_options.token: Use an existing account ID and token

login.title: Sign in to SmartTherm
login.description: Enter the email/login name and password used in the SmartTherm app. The account ID and token are retrieved automatically; only the resulting session is saved.

token.title: Enter an existing token
token.description: Enter a valid token. For a new connection, also enter the numeric account user ID.

error.invalid_auth: The email/password or account ID/token is invalid or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to SmartTherm. Try again later.
error.no_devices: No supported online thermostats (models 08/09) were found.
error.wrong_account: This login belongs to a different account. Sign in to the account already configured, or add it as a separate integration.

abort.already_configured: This SmartTherm account is already configured.
